name: restoring-embers-influence-four-recovers-and-draws-into-memory
notes: Restoring Embers (FnTT1G4OQg): four payers go to memory so influence (hand + memory) is exactly four; the champion recovers 4 and a card is drawn into memory. Pre-fix this died with an undefined-function fatal after the recovery.

rulesClauses: Recover 4. Then if your influence is four or less, draw a card into your memory.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated cardActivatedAbilities["FnTT1G4OQg:0"] body called DrawToMemory(), which does not exist in GrandArchiveSim (the engine function is DrawIntoMemory()): every resolution with influence four or less recovered the champion and then died with a fatal 'Call to undefined function DrawToMemory()', leaving the effect unresolved. The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the closure is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with DrawIntoMemory().
